note: LINQ: Enumerable operators without delegates or comparers read every sequence and value they are given deep: the eager ones at the call, and Skip, Take, Cast, OfType and Union, which return a library sequence of their sources' elements, where that sequence is enumerated. Every Enumerable operator that takes a delegate and no comparer is described (phase 5c run B): its delegates run where the sequence it returns is enumerated (iterator) or, for any other operator, during the call (invoke-now), each handed the elements of its sources, and its result is what it yields or returns. Operators taking a comparer, CountBy and AggregateBy among them, stay opaque. Queryable operators touch nothing because an expression tree is data.
